title: Porting a Javalin route, service and repository to Spring Boot

objectives.text: Port the Java Foundations Javalin route, service and in-memory repository to a Spring Boot controller, @Service and @Repository with the same JSON responses
Replace Javalin exception mapping with a Spring handler that returns the same 400 and 404 responses
Verify the port by running the same requests against both versions and comparing status codes and bodies
